*** Add File: /mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/codex/solver/athena_wind/radial_audit.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Check steady hot-wind mass flux and Bernoulli invariant against its root."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+AU=149597870700.;DAY=86400.;VUNIT=AU/DAY
+KB=1.380649e-23;MP=1.67262192369e-27
+r0=.0999850461106864;gamma=1.5;gm=.0002959122082855911
+v0=400000/VUNIT;rho0=5/r0**2
+p0=2*rho0*KB*1800000/(MP*VUNIT**2)
+mass=rho0*v0*r0**2
+entropy=p0/rho0**gamma
+energy=.5*v0**2+gamma/(gamma-1)*p0/rho0-gm/r0
+
+
+def solution(r):
+    # The requested branch is supersonic and accelerating, hence the largest
+    # positive Bernoulli root. Bracket above the sonic-point minimum.
+    sonic=(gamma*entropy*(mass/r**2)**(gamma-1))**(1/(gamma+1))
+    lo=sonic*(1+1e-10)
+    hi=np.sqrt(2*(energy+gm/r))*(1+1e-9)
+    for _ in range(80):
+        v=.5*(lo+hi);rho=mass/(v*r**2)
+        residual=.5*v*v+gamma/(gamma-1)*entropy*rho**(gamma-1)-gm/r-energy
+        lo,hi=(v,hi) if residual<0 else (lo,v)
+    v=.5*(lo+hi);rho=mass/(v*r**2)
+    return v*VUNIT/1000,rho
+
+
+result={"problem":"Steady supersonic adiabatic radial wind, Tinner=1.8MK, gamma1.5, solar gravity",
+        "inner_mass_flux_code":mass,"Bernoulli_constant_code":energy,"cases":{}}
+for name in ["hot_radial_main","hot_radial_athena"]:
+    folder=HERE/name
+    a=np.genfromtxt(folder/"probe.csv",delimiter=",",names=True)
+    a=a[(a["probe_id"]==0)&(a["day"]>30)]
+    expected=np.array([solution(r) for r in a["r_au"]])
+    mass_ratio=a["n_cm3"]*a["vr_kms"]*1000/VUNIT*a["r_au"]**2/mass
+    result["cases"][name]=dict(mean_density_relative_error=float(np.mean(a["n_cm3"]/expected[:,1]-1)),
+        maximum_abs_density_relative_error=float(np.max(abs(a["n_cm3"]/expected[:,1]-1))),
+        mean_radial_speed_relative_error=float(np.mean(a["vr_kms"]/expected[:,0]-1)),
+        maximum_abs_radial_speed_relative_error=float(np.max(abs(a["vr_kms"]/expected[:,0]-1))),
+        mean_mass_flux_relative_error=float(np.mean(mass_ratio-1)),
+        maximum_abs_mass_flux_relative_error=float(np.max(abs(mass_ratio-1))),
+        first_expected_speed_kms=float(expected[0,0]),first_model_speed_kms=float(a["vr_kms"][0]),
+        maximum_transverse_speed_kms=float(np.max(np.hypot(a["vtheta_kms"],a["vphi_kms"]))))
+(HERE/"hot_radial_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
+print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
*** End Patch"));
